inputs.name: article_id
inputs.about: Unique ID of the Help Center article.

tools.name: Get Attachment
tools.description: Retrieve details of a single Zendesk attachment by ID, including available file metadata, URLs, and thumbnails.

inputs.name: attachment_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the attachment to retrieve. You can find attachment IDs in ticket comments or via the attachments list endpoint.

tools.name: Get Autocomplete Tags
tools.description: Search for Zendesk tags using autocomplete. Use when you need to find tag suggestions based on a partial tag name for tagging tickets or organizing content.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: A substring of a tag name to search for. The API returns registered and recent tags matching this substring.

tools.name: Show Automation
tools.description: Show a specific automation by its ID. Use when you need to retrieve details of a single automation rule in your Zendesk account, such as for auditing, modifying, or understanding what actions and conditions are configured for a particular automation. This action is read-only and idempotent.

inputs.name: automation_id
inputs.about: The ID of the automation to retrieve

tools.name: List Automations
tools.description: List Zendesk automations for review or auditing, with page and page-size parameters and an optional active-status filter.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: Traditional: `?page=2` (integer page number). Cursor: `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor` (deepObject with size, after, before). These are mutually exclusive - use one format or the other, not both.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Field to sort results by. Prefix with `-` for descending order. When used with cursor pagination, this determines the cursor ordering. Example: `?sort=name` or `?sort=-created_at`

inputs.name: active
inputs.about: Filter by active automations if true or inactive automations if false

inputs.name: include
inputs.about: A sideload to include in the response. See Zendesk API documentation for available sideloads.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page. Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.

tools.name: Search Automations
tools.description: Search for Zendesk automations by their title. Use when you need to find automations in your Zendesk account by searching for keywords in their titles. Automations are business rules that automatically perform actions when certain conditions are met. This action supports filtering by active status and sorting results.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Query string used to find all automations with matching title. Case-insensitive partial match on automation titles.

inputs.name: active
inputs.about: Filter automations by active status. Set to true to return only active automations, or false to return only inactive automations. When not specified, returns both active and inactive automations.

inputs.name: include
inputs.about: Sideload related data to include in the response. Currently supported: 'usage_24h' returns statistics about how many times each automation was triggered in the last 24 hours.

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: Field to sort results by. Options: 'alphabetical' (sorts A-Z), 'created_at' (by creation date), 'updated_at' (by last modification), 'position' (by dashboard position). If unspecified, automations are sorted by relevance to the query.

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.about: Sort order direction. Options: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'asc' for alphabetical and position sorts, 'desc' for created_at and updated_at sorts.

tools.name: List Brands
tools.description: List Zendesk brands and retrieve metadata such as default status, subdomain, and host mapping. Supports cursor pagination and a per-page parameter.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Field to sort results by. Prefix with `-` for descending order. When used with cursor pagination, this determines the cursor ordering.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page. Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of brands to return per page (cursor pagination). Sent as the 'page[size]' query parameter.

inputs.name: page_after
inputs.about: Cursor for the next page of results (cursor pagination). Use the value from the previous response's 'links.next' URL. Sent as the 'page[after]' query parameter.

tools.name: Get Zendesk Brand
tools.description: Show a Brand. Use when you have a brand ID and need to retrieve detailed information about a specific Zendesk brand, including its name, subdomain, active status, Help Center configuration, logo, and associated ticket forms.

inputs.name: brand_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the brand to retrieve. This is the brand ID returned from list brands operations.

tools.name: List Agents by Brand
tools.description: List agents assigned to a specific brand in Zendesk. Use when you need to enumerate which agents have access to a specific brand, such as auditing brand access permissions or determining which agents can access a brand's help center. This is a read-only, idempotent operation.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: Traditional: `?page=2` (integer page number). Cursor: `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor` (deepObject with size, after, before). These are mutually exclusive - use one format or the other, not both.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Field to sort results by. Prefix with `-` for descending order. When used with cursor pagination, this determines the cursor ordering.

inputs.name: brand_id
inputs.about: The ID of the brand to list agents for.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page. Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.

tools.name: Get Current OAuth Token
tools.description: Get non-secret metadata for the OAuth token used by this connection.

tools.name: Get Custom Object Fields Limit
tools.description: Get the current count and maximum limit for custom object fields in Zendesk. Returns the number of fields currently defined for a specific custom object and the maximum allowed limit. Use when you need to check how many fields have been created for a custom object and how much capacity remains before hitting the limit. This is a read-only operation that does not modify any data.

inputs.name: custom_object_key
inputs.about: The key of a custom object

tools.name: Get Custom Object Records Limit
tools.description: Get the current record limit and usage count for custom objects in Zendesk. Returns the current number of custom object records and the maximum allowed limit. Use when you need to check how many custom object records have been created and how much capacity remains. This is a read-only operation that does not modify any data.

tools.name: Get Custom Objects Limit
tools.description: Get the current count and maximum limit for custom objects in Zendesk. Use when you need to check how many custom objects exist in your Zendesk account and what the allowed limit is, to avoid exceeding capacity or to plan for scaling.

tools.name: Get Custom Status
tools.description: Get a specific custom ticket status from Zendesk by its ID. Use when you have a custom status ID from ticket payloads or from listing custom statuses and need to retrieve the full status details including agent/end-user labels, descriptions, and status category. This is a read-only, idempotent operation that retrieves the current state of a custom ticket status.

inputs.name: custom_status_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the custom status to retrieve. This is the custom status ID found in ticket payloads or from listing custom statuses.

tools.name: List Custom Ticket Statuses
tools.description: List custom ticket statuses available in a Zendesk account. Use when you need to retrieve all undeleted custom ticket statuses, optionally filtered by status category, active state, or default status. This action is useful for understanding available custom statuses for ticket workflows, automation rules, or displaying status options to users.

inputs.name: active
inputs.about: If true, show only active custom ticket statuses. If false, show only inactive custom ticket statuses. If the filter is not used, show all custom ticket statuses.

inputs.name: default
inputs.about: If true, show only default custom ticket statuses. If false, show only non-default custom ticket statuses. If the filter is not used, show all custom ticket statuses.

inputs.name: status_categories
inputs.about: Filter the list of custom ticket statuses by a comma-separated list of status categories. Example: 'new,open,pending'

tools.name: List Deleted Tickets
tools.description: Lists tickets that have been deleted from Zendesk, showing up to 100 deleted tickets per page with pagination. Use when you need to retrieve information about previously deleted tickets or audit ticket deletions. This action is read-only and idempotent.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: Traditional: ?page=2 (integer page number). Cursor: ?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor (deepObject with size, after, before). These are mutually exclusive.

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: Sort field options for deleted tickets.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page (max 100). Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.about: Sort order options.

inputs.name: support_type_scope
inputs.about: Support type scope options.

tools.name: Get Deleted User
tools.description: Retrieves a single deleted Zendesk user by their ID. Use when you have a specific deleted user ID and need to fetch details about that deleted user, such as for auditing purposes, account recovery, or compliance records. Deleted users retain their associated tickets and historical data.

inputs.name: deleted_user_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the deleted user to retrieve. You can find this from the deleted users list endpoint or from previous user search results.

tools.name: Get Deletion Schedule
tools.description: Retrieve a specific deletion schedule from Zendesk by its ID. Use this action when you need to get the details of a particular deletion schedule, including its title, description, active status, object type, conditions, and creation/update timestamps. This action is read-only and idempotent.

inputs.name: deletion_schedule_id
inputs.about: The unique ID of the deletion schedule to retrieve. Must be a non-negative integer.

tools.name: List Deletion Schedules
tools.description: List all deletion schedules for the current Zendesk account. Use when you need to retrieve, audit, or review the deletion schedule rules configured in your Zendesk account. Deletion schedules define automated data retention policies that periodically remove specified entity types based on configured conditions. Only Zendesk admins can access this endpoint.

tools.name: List Dynamic Content Items
tools.description: List dynamic content items configured in your Zendesk account, including localization variants and placeholder metadata. This read-only operation supports offset pagination and sorting.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page. Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.

tools.name: Show Dynamic Content Item
tools.description: Show a specific dynamic content item by its ID. inputs.name: dynamic_content_item_id

tools.name: Show Many Dynamic Content Items

inputs.name: identifiers

tools.name: List Dynamic Content Variants
tools.description: List all variants of a specific Zendesk dynamic content item. inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page. Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.

inputs.name: dynamic_content_item_id
inputs.about: The ID of the dynamic content item whose variants to retrieve.

tools.name: Show Dynamic Content Item Variant
tools.description: Show a specific variant of a dynamic content item in Zendesk. inputs.about: The ID of the dynamic content item

inputs.name: dynamic_content_variant_id
inputs.about: The ID of the variant

tools.name: Get Email Notification

inputs.name: notification_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the email notification to retrieve. You can find notification IDs from ticket audit logs or email notification list responses.

tools.name: Get Email Notifications
tools.description: List email notifications from Zendesk. Use this action when you need to retrieve email notification records filtered by ticket, comment, or notification ID. tools.name: Get Group

inputs.name: group_id

tools.name: Get Group Membership

tools.name: List Memberships By Group

inputs.name: per_page

tools.name: List Assignable Groups
tools.description: List all groups that can be assigned to tickets or users in your Zendesk account. Use when you need to enumerate available groups for assignment operations, check group availability, or retrieve group metadata. This is a read-only, idempotent operation.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for offset pagination (1-100). Limited to first 100 pages or 10,000 records total.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page (max 100). Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of records per page for cursor pagination (max 100). Use this for large datasets.

inputs.name: page_after
inputs.about: Cursor value to retrieve the next page of results. Obtained from previous response's 'next_page' or cursor.

inputs.name: page_before
inputs.about: Cursor value to retrieve the previous page of results. Obtained from previous response's 'prev' or cursor.

tools.name: Count Groups
tools.description: Count groups in Zendesk. Returns an approximate count of groups in the system. Use when you need to know how many groups exist for reporting, organizational management, or operational purposes. This action is read-only and idempotent.

tools.name: Count Users by Group
tools.description: Count users in a specific Zendesk group. Returns an approximate count of users belonging to the specified group, with optional filtering by role or permission set. Use when you need to know how many users are in a particular group for reporting, resource planning, or administrative purposes. This action is read-only and idempotent.

inputs.name: role
inputs.about: User role values for filtering.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the group whose users will be counted. This is the group ID from the Groups API.

inputs.name: role_list
inputs.about: Filter the results by more than one role. Provide a list of roles to include users matching any of them.

inputs.name: permission_set
inputs.about: Filter by custom role ID (Enterprise plan and above). Only one role ID per request is allowed.

tools.name: List Group Users
tools.description: List a page of users belonging to a specific Zendesk group, with optional filtering by user role, permission set, or external ID. This is a read-only operation.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: traditional uses `?page=2` (integer page number); cursor uses `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor` (deepObject with size, after, before). These are mutually exclusive.

inputs.name: role
inputs.about: Filter results by a single role. Use 'end-user', 'agent', or 'admin'.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the group. Users belonging to this group will be returned.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page. Maximum is 100 records per page for the group users endpoint.

inputs.name: role_list
inputs.about: Filter results by multiple roles. Provide a list of roles to include users matching any of them.

inputs.name: external_id
inputs.about: Filter by external ID. Must be unique per user under the same account.

inputs.name: permission_set
inputs.about: Filter by custom role ID (Enterprise plan only). Only one role ID per request.

tools.name: List Guide Survey Responses
tools.description: List survey responses from Zendesk Guide. Use when you need to retrieve CSAT survey responses, analyze customer satisfaction scores, or monitor survey completion rates. Survey responses are available on Support Professional plan and above, and Zendesk Suite Growth plan and above. This action is read-only and idempotent.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Sort order for survey responses. Use 'id' for ascending or '-id' for descending order.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of survey responses to return per page (max 100).

inputs.name: page_after
inputs.about: Cursor to retrieve the next page of results. Use the 'after_cursor' value from a previous response.

inputs.name: page_before
inputs.about: Cursor to retrieve the previous page of results. Use the 'before_cursor' value from a previous response.

inputs.name: filter_subject_zrns
inputs.about: Filter survey responses by subject Zendesk Resource Names (ZRNs). Format: 'zen:ticket:123' for tickets. Example: ['zen:ticket:1', 'zen:ticket:2']

inputs.name: filter_responder_ids
inputs.about: Filter survey responses by responder user IDs. Pass a list of user IDs to only include responses from these users.

inputs.name: filter_created_at_end
inputs.about: Filter survey responses created on or before this date. Use ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T23:59:59Z').

inputs.name: filter_created_at_start
inputs.about: Filter survey responses created on or after this date. Use ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T00:00:00Z').

tools.name: List Guide Surveys
tools.description: List available CSAT (Customer Satisfaction) surveys in Zendesk Guide. Use when you need to retrieve survey definitions, check which surveys are enabled/disabled, or get survey questions and versions. The response includes survey IDs, states, creation timestamps, and question arrays. This is a read-only, idempotent operation.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.about: The locale used for the display of the corresponding survey questions and options. Example: 'en-us', 'fr-fr', 'de-de'

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of surveys to return per page (max 100). Use for paginating through large result sets.

inputs.name: page_after
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination to retrieve the next page of results. Obtain from previous response's next_page link.

inputs.name: filter_types
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of survey types to filter the results. Common types include 'csat' for customer satisfaction surveys.

tools.name: Get Guide Theme Job
tools.description: Retrieve one Guide theming job by ID.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: ID of the Guide theming job to retrieve.

tools.name: Get Incremental Organizations
tools.description: Retrieve organizations that have been modified since a specified start time using the Incremental Organization Export API. Use when you need to sync or track changes to Zendesk organizations over time. Provide a start_time (Unix timestamp) from a previous response's end_time to paginate through changes incrementally. This action is read-only and idempotent. Organizations may be created, updated, or appear as deleted; interpret based on your use case. Rate limiting may apply for large accounts.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page (max 100). Default varies by API tier.

inputs.name: start_time
inputs.about: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) to start the incremental export from. Must be at least one minute in the past. Data isn't provided for the most recent minute. Use the end_time from a previous response for subsequent pagination.

tools.name: Incremental Routing Attributes Export
tools.description: Export routing attributes incrementally with optional start_time filtering and cursor-based pagination. Use when you need to retrieve all skill-based routing attributes (attributes, attribute values, and instance values) that have changed in your Zendesk account. This is a read-only operation that returns a stream of changes; it does not include data from the most recent minute. For large datasets, use cursor-based pagination with the after_cursor value from responses. This action is read-only and idempotent — calling it multiple times with the same start_time returns the same results.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: The cursor pointer for pagination. Use the after_cursor value from a previous response to fetch subsequent pages of records.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page. Default and maximum is 1000.

inputs.name: start_time
inputs.about: The Unix timestamp to start the incremental export from. The result set includes only records created at or after this time. If not specified, returns records from the beginning of time. Note: Data isn't provided for the most recent minute.

tools.name: Get Incremental Routing Attribute Values
tools.description: Retrieve routing attribute values that have been modified since a specified start time using the Incremental Skill-Based Routing API. Use when you need to sync or track changes to routing attributes, values, and their associations over time. Provide a start_time (Unix timestamp) and the API returns all attribute values modified since that time. Call repeatedly with the end_time from each response to paginate through all changes. This action is read-only and idempotent. Note: Data isn't available for the most recent minute due to eventual consistency. Attribute values may appear as modified; interpret based on your use case.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: A non-human-readable cursor for pagination. Use the next_page URL from a previous response to move forward through results. The cursor is read-only and only available in API responses.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page (max 3000).

inputs.name: start_time
inputs.about: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) marking the start of the incremental export window. Must be at least one minute in the past. Data isn't provided for the most recent minute. Use the end_time from a previous response for subsequent pagination.

tools.name: Export Incremental Routing Instance Values
tools.description: Export incremental routing instance values from Zendesk skill-based routing. Returns a stream of changes that occurred on routing attributes, attribute values, and instance values. Use this action when you need to synchronize routing configuration data or monitor changes to skill-based routing assignments. This action is read-only and supports cursor-based pagination with a maximum of 3000 records per page. Stop paging when the count is 0. Note: The cursor parameter is read-only and should only be obtained from API responses, not manually constructed.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: A non-human-readable cursor to move forward or backward in time for pagination. Read-only and only available in API responses.

tools.name: Get Incremental Sample Export
tools.description: Request a sample incremental export for a resource since a specified start time, to test an export setup. The response exposes ticket records but not user or organization record arrays; data from the most recent minute is not provided.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page (max 100).

inputs.name: start_time
inputs.about: The Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) to start the incremental export from. Must be at least one minute in the past. Data isn't provided for the most recent minute.

inputs.name: incremental_resource
inputs.about: The incremental resource to sample. Supported values include 'tickets', 'users', 'organizations', and other incremental export types available in the Zendesk API.

tools.name: Get Incremental Ticket Events
tools.description: Export incremental ticket events from Zendesk. Use when you need to track changes to tickets over time, monitor agent performance metrics, or sync ticket event data with an external system. This action returns a stream of ticket metric events (like agent work time, reply times) that occurred after the specified start_time. Call repeatedly with the end_time from each response to continue exporting events. Data isn't available for the most recent minute due to eventual consistency. Note: This is a read-only, idempotent operation. The start_time must be at least one minute in the past.

inputs.name: include
inputs.about: Sideloads to include in the response. Accepts a comma-separated list of values. Supports 'comment_events' to include full comment data in the response.

inputs.name: start_time
inputs.about: The time to start the incremental export from. Must be at least one minute in the past. Data isn't provided for the most recent minute due to eventual consistency delays.

inputs.name: support_type_scope
inputs.about: Scope for filtering tickets by support type.

tools.name: List Ticket Metric Events
tools.description: List ticket metric events in Zendesk that occurred on or after a specified time. This action supports incremental data export — use the end_time from one response as the start_time for the next request to retrieve subsequent events. This action is read-only and idempotent — use it to monitor ticket metrics, track SLA compliance, or build analytics dashboards. Note: deleted tickets can create orphan metric events; use exclude_deleted=true to filter these out.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for offset pagination. Zendesk returns up to 1000 records per page for incremental exports.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records per page (max 1000 for incremental exports).

inputs.name: start_time
inputs.about: The Unix UTC epoch time of the oldest event you're interested in. Only events that occurred on or after this time are returned. Example: 1332034771.

inputs.name: exclude_deleted
inputs.about: When true, excludes ticket metric events for deleted tickets. Use this to avoid receiving events for tickets that have been deleted.

inputs.name: include_changes
inputs.about: This optional parameter enhances incremental data retrieval, delivering a consistent and accurate representation of data changes.

tools.name: Get Incremental Tickets
tools.description: Retrieve tickets modified since a specified start time using the incremental ticket export, and use the response's end_time for subsequent requests. The support type defaults to agent; select all to include other support types, and note that data from the most recent minute is not provided.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of tickets to return per page (max 1000). Default varies by API tier.

inputs.name: start_time
inputs.about: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) to start the incremental export from. Must be at least one minute in the past. Data isn't provided for the most recent minute. Use the end_time from a previous response for subsequent pagination.

inputs.name: support_type_scope
inputs.about: Filter tickets by support type. Possible values are 'all', 'agent', or 'ai_agent'. Defaults to 'agent'.

tools.name: Get Incremental Tickets (Cursor)
tools.description: Export tickets incrementally using cursor-based pagination for synchronization, backups, or analytics. Supply a start time for the initial request and use the returned cursor in subsequent requests to fetch further pages.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: The cursor pointer for pagination. Use the after_cursor value from a previous response to fetch subsequent pages of tickets.

inputs.name: start_time
inputs.about: The Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) to start the incremental export from. Must be at least one minute in the past. Data isn't provided for the most recent minute. Required on the initial export request; not required on subsequent cursor-based pagination requests.

inputs.name: support_type_scope
inputs.about: Filter tickets by support type. Possible values are 'all', 'agent', or 'ai_agent'. Defaults to 'agent'.

tools.name: Get Incremental Users
tools.description: Retrieve users that have been modified since a specified start time using the Incremental User Export API. Use when you need to sync or track changes to Zendesk users over time, such as for data warehousing, backup, or external system synchronization. Provide a start_time (Unix timestamp) and the API returns users that have been created, updated, or deleted since that time. Call repeatedly with the end_time from each response to paginate through all changes. This action is read-only and idempotent. Note: Data isn't available for the most recent minute due to eventual consistency. Users may appear as modified or deleted; interpret based on your use case.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: The number of records to return per page (max 100).

inputs.name: start_time
inputs.about: The Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) to start the incremental export from. Must be at least one minute in the past. Data isn't provided for the most recent minute. Use the end_time from a previous response for subsequent pagination.

tools.name: Incremental User Export (Cursor)
tools.description: Export users incrementally using cursor-based pagination. Use when you need to export all users from Zendesk in a reliable, paginated manner. The start_time parameter is required for the initial request to define the time range. Subsequent requests use the cursor returned in previous responses to fetch the next batch of records. This action is ideal for: - Full user data synchronization to external systems - Regular incremental backups of user data - Building user directories with pagination support Note: Data from the most recent minute is not included to ensure consistency.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: The cursor pointer to work with for all subsequent exports after the initial request. Use the cursor returned in the previous response to paginate through all records.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: The number of records to return per page (max 100).

inputs.name: start_time
inputs.about: The time to start the incremental export from. Must be at least one minute in the past. Data isn't provided for the most recent minute. Required on the initial export request; not required on subsequent cursor-based pagination requests.

tools.name: Get Incremental Voice Calls
tools.description: Export Zendesk Talk call statistics modified on or after a Unix timestamp. Call again with end_time as start_time to continue exporting calls. next_page is not null on the last page; use count to decide whether more calls are available.

inputs.name: start_time
inputs.about: Oldest call update time to include, expressed as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

tools.name: List Job Statuses
tools.description: List job statuses from Zendesk. Shows the status of all background jobs that have been initiated, including those created by bulk operations like bulk updates, imports, or exports. Each job status includes progress information, completion status, and any results from individual tasks. Use this action to track the progress of long-running operations or check if background tasks completed successfully. Use this action when you need to check the status of background jobs, monitor bulk operation progress, or verify that asynchronous tasks have finished processing.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of records per page for cursor pagination (max 100). Default varies by endpoint.

inputs.name: page_after
inputs.about: Cursor token to fetch records after this position. Use the 'after_cursor' value from a previous response to get the next page.

inputs.name: page_before
inputs.about: Cursor token to fetch records before this position. Use the 'before_cursor' value from a previous response to get the previous page.

tools.name: Get Job Status
tools.description: Get a single job status by ID from Zendesk. Shows the status of a background job initiated by bulk operations (like bulk updates, imports, or exports). The response includes progress information, completion status, and any results from individual tasks. Use this action when you have a job_status_id from a previously queued bulk operation and need to check if it completed successfully, failed, or is still processing. Check the 'status' field for the current state ('queued', 'working', 'completed', 'failed') and the 'results' array for individual task outcomes.

inputs.name: job_status_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the job status to retrieve. This is the job ID returned when a bulk operation was queued.

tools.name: Get Locale
tools.description: Get a locale by its ID or BCP-47 code. Use when you need to retrieve details about a specific locale including the locale identifier, language name, and timestamps.

inputs.name: locale_id
inputs.about: The ID or the BCP-47 code of the locale. Examples: es-419, en-us, pr-br, or numeric ID like 1

tools.name: List Locales
tools.description: List all translation locales available for your Zendesk account. Use when you need to retrieve the available locales for translation purposes, check which languages are enabled, or get locale metadata including the locale code, display name, and creation timestamps. This is a read-only, idempotent operation that supports pagination.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page (max 100).

tools.name: List Agent Locales
tools.description: List the translation locales that have been localized for agent use. Use when you need to discover which locales are available for agents to work with in multilingual support scenarios. This is a read-only, idempotent operation that requires no parameters.

tools.name: Get Current Locale
tools.description: Show the current locale for a Zendesk account. Use when you need to determine what language/locale is currently active for the account, which affects how content is displayed to end users and which translations are available.

tools.name: Get Localized Article
tools.description: Retrieve one localized Zendesk Help Center article by ID.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.about: Enabled Help Center locale, such as 'en-us' or 'es-419'.

inputs.name: include
inputs.about: Comma-separated related resources to sideload. Supported values are users, sections, categories, and translations.

inputs.name: article_id
inputs.about: Help Center article ID, as a string.

tools.name: Show Macro
tools.description: Show a specific macro by its ID. Use when you need to retrieve details of a single macro in your Zendesk account, such as for auditing, modifying, or understanding what actions and conditions are configured for a particular macro. Macros are saved response templates that agents can apply to tickets. Supports optional sideloads for usage statistics and additional metadata via the `include` parameter.

inputs.name: include
inputs.about: A sideload to include in the response. See Zendesk API documentation for available sideloads such as 'usage_7d', 'usage_24h', 'usage_30d', 'permissions', or 'categories'.

inputs.name: macro_id
inputs.about: The ID of the macro to retrieve

tools.name: List Macro Attachments
tools.description: List attachment metadata for a specific Zendesk macro, including filenames, content types, sizes, and download URLs. The response may include a next-page URL.

inputs.name: macro_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the macro whose attachments to list. You can find macro IDs from the macros list endpoint or the macro URL.

tools.name: List Macro Categories
tools.description: List all macro categories available to the current Zendesk account. Use when you need to retrieve or browse available macro categories for organizing and applying macros to tickets. This action is read-only and idempotent.

tools.name: List Macro Action Definitions
tools.description: Retrieve the definitions of all actions that a macro can perform in Zendesk. Use this action when you need to discover what actions are available for macro creation, understand the available values for each action type, or build a macro configuration interface. The response includes action fields, their display titles, types, and available value options. Common macro actions include: setting ticket status, priority, or type; assigning agents or groups; adding/removing tags; setting custom fields; and adding comments.

tools.name: Show Macro Replica
tools.description: Show a macro replica (unpersisted macro representation) based on a macro ID and ticket ID. Use when you need to preview how a macro will look when applied to a specific ticket, allowing you to see the actions and values that will be applied without actually applying the macro. This is useful for testing macro configurations or displaying macro previews in your interface. This action is read-only and idempotent.

inputs.name: macro_id
inputs.about: The ID of the macro to replicate

inputs.name: ticket_id
inputs.about: The ID of the ticket from which to build a macro replica

tools.name: List Macros
tools.description: List all shared and personal macros available in your Zendesk account. Use when you need to retrieve, audit, or review the macros configured for automating ticket responses and actions. Macros are saved response templates that agents can apply to tickets. Supports filtering by access level, active status, category, and group. Results can be sorted by name, creation date, update date, or usage statistics.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: Traditional: `?page=2` (integer page number). Cursor: `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor` (deepObject with size, after, before). These are mutually exclusive - use one format or the other, not both.

inputs.name: access
inputs.about: Filter macros by access. Possible values are 'personal', 'agents', 'shared', or 'account'. The 'agents' value returns all personal macros for the account's agents and is only available to admins.

inputs.name: active
inputs.about: Filter by active macros if true or inactive macros if false

inputs.name: include
inputs.about: A sideload to include in the response. See Zendesk API documentation for available sideloads.

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: Sort order for results. Possible values are 'alphabetical', 'created_at', 'updated_at', 'usage_1h', 'usage_24h', 'usage_7d', or 'usage_30d'. Defaults to alphabetical

inputs.name: category
inputs.about: Filter macros by category ID

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: Filter macros by group ID

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page. Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.about: Sort direction. One of 'asc' or 'desc'. Defaults to 'asc' for alphabetical and position sort, 'desc' for all others

inputs.name: only_viewable
inputs.about: If true, returns only macros that can be applied to tickets. If false, returns all macros the current user can manage. Defaults to false

tools.name: List Macro Actions
tools.description: List supported actions for macros in Zendesk. Use when you need to discover what field modifications are available when creating or editing macros. This endpoint returns the available action fields that can be set in a macro (e.g., status, priority, assignee, etc.) along with their possible values. This is useful for validating macro configurations or building macro management interfaces. This action is read-only and idempotent.

tools.name: List Active Macros
tools.description: List all active shared and personal macros in Zendesk. Use when you need to retrieve, audit, or review the macros configured in your Zendesk account. Macros are saved responses that agents can apply to tickets. This action supports filtering by access level, category, group, and sorting options. Note: This action only returns active macros. The sort_by parameter supports sorting by usage metrics (usage_1h, usage_24h, usage_7d, usage_30d) to identify the most frequently used macros.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for offset pagination. Zendesk returns up to 100 records per page.

inputs.name: access
inputs.about: Filter macros by access level.

inputs.name: include
inputs.about: A sideload to include in the response. See Zendesk API documentation for available sideloads.

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: Possible values for sorting macros.

inputs.name: category
inputs.about: Filter macros by category ID

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: Filter macros by group ID

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of macros per page for offset pagination (max 100).

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Records per page for cursor pagination (sent as page[size], max 100).

inputs.name: page_after
inputs.about: Cursor for forward cursor pagination (sent as page[after]).

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.about: Sort order for macro listing.

inputs.name: page_before
inputs.about: Cursor for backward cursor pagination (sent as page[before]).

tools.name: Show Changes to Ticket
tools.description: Show changes to a ticket that would result from applying a macro. Use when you need to preview what changes a macro would make to a ticket before actually applying it. This allows you to review the changes that would be applied, such as assignee changes, group reassignments, comments, or custom field updates. This action is read-only and idempotent — it does not actually modify the ticket.

inputs.name: macro_id
inputs.about: The ID of the macro to preview

tools.name: Search Macros
tools.description: Search for Zendesk macros by their title. Use when you need to find macros in your Zendesk account by searching for keywords in their titles. Macros are pre-defined responses or actions that can be applied to tickets to automate repetitive tasks. This action supports filtering by access, active status, category, and group, as well as sorting results.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Query string used to find macros with matching titles. Case-insensitive partial match on macro titles.

inputs.name: access
inputs.about: Filter macros by access. Options: 'personal' (user's own macros), 'agents' (all personal macros for account's agents, admin only), 'shared' (macros shared with the user), 'account' (account-level macros).

inputs.name: active
inputs.about: Filter by active macros if true or inactive macros if false. When not specified, returns both active and inactive macros.

inputs.name: include
inputs.about: A sideload to include in the response. See Zendesk docs for available sideloads (e.g., 'usage_7d' returns usage statistics for the last 7 days).

inputs.name: sort_by

inputs.name: category
inputs.about: Filter macros by category ID.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: Filter macros by group ID.

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.about: Sort order direction. Options: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'asc' for alphabetical and position sorts, 'desc' for created_at and updated_at sorts.

inputs.name: only_viewable
inputs.about: If true, returns only macros that can be applied to tickets. If false (default), returns all macros the current user can manage.

tools.name: Show Object Trigger
tools.description: Show a specific trigger for a custom object in Zendesk. Use when you need to retrieve details of a single trigger, such as for auditing, understanding its conditions and actions, or preparing modifications. This action is read-only and idempotent.

inputs.name: trigger_id
inputs.about: The ID of the trigger to retrieve

inputs.name: custom_object_key
inputs.about: The key of a custom object (e.g., 'car', 'order')

tools.name: List Open Requests
tools.description: List open requests from Zendesk. Use this action when you need to retrieve all requests with "open" status for the authenticated user. Supports sorting by creation date or last update time. This action is read-only and idempotent.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for paginating through results (starts at 1).

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: Sort field options for listing open requests.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of requests per page (max 100).

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.about: Sort order options for listing open requests.

tools.name: Get Organization Field
tools.description: Get details for a specific organization field in Zendesk by its ID or key. Use this action when you need to retrieve detailed information about a single custom organization field, including its type, options, validation rules, and display settings. This is useful for understanding field configuration or before updating/deleting a field. Returns the complete organization field definition with all metadata.

inputs.name: resolve_dc
inputs.about: If true, resolves dynamic content placeholders in the response

inputs.name: organization_field_id
inputs.about: The ID or key of the organization field to retrieve

tools.name: List Organization Fields
tools.description: List Zendesk organization field definitions, with an optional page parameter and dynamic content resolution. The response includes pagination links.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Cursor-based pagination parameter. Supports JSON:API style: `page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor` or `page[before]=cursor`. Traditional offset: `page=2` (integer). Cannot mix formats.

inputs.name: resolve_dc
inputs.about: If true, resolves dynamic content placeholders in the response

tools.name: Get Organization Membership
tools.description: Get details for a specific organization membership by its ID. Use when you have an organization membership ID and need to retrieve the associated user, organization, and membership metadata. This action is read-only and idempotent - calling it multiple times with the same membership ID will return the same result.

inputs.name: organization_membership_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the organization membership to retrieve

tools.name: Get Organization Related Info
tools.description: Get related counts and information for a specific Zendesk organization by ID. Returns metadata about tickets, users, groups, activities, and other related resources associated with the organization. Use when you need to understand the scale and composition of an organization's resources in Zendesk. This is a read-only, idempotent operation.

inputs.name: organization_id
inputs.about: Numeric ID of the organization to retrieve related information for (e.g. 123456). Must be a non-null integer; cast to int if sourced from tools that return it as a string. Do not pass null (skip the call if ticket's organization_id is null). Obtain from ZENDESK_GET_ALL_ZENDESK_ORGANIZATIONS or ZENDE

tools.name: List Organization Requests
tools.description: List requests for a specific Zendesk organization. Use when you need to retrieve all requests associated with a particular organization. This action returns request details including subject, status, priority, requester, and timestamps. Pagination is available for large result sets.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination (1-100). Limited to first 100 pages or 10,000 records total. For larger datasets, use cursor pagination instead.

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: Field to sort requests by. Options are 'updated_at' or 'created_at'.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of requests per page (max 100). Note: page * per_page cannot exceed 10,000. Set to 100 for large accounts to minimize requests before client-side filtering.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of requests per page for cursor pagination (max 100). Use this for large datasets instead of page/per_page.

inputs.name: page_after
inputs.about: Cursor value to retrieve the next page of results. Obtained from previous response's 'after_cursor' or 'next' link.

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.about: Sort order direction. Options are 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'asc' if not specified.

inputs.name: page_before
inputs.about: Cursor value to retrieve the previous page of results. Obtained from previous response's 'before_cursor' or 'prev' link.

inputs.name: organization_id
inputs.about: Numeric ID of the organization whose requests to retrieve. Must be a non-null integer; cast to int if sourced from tools that return it as a string. Do not pass null (skip the call if organization_id is null). Obtain from ZENDESK_GET_ALL_ZENDESK_ORGANIZATIONS or ZENDESK_CREATE_ZENDESK_ORGANIZATION;

tools.name: Autocomplete Organizations
tools.description: Search for Zendesk organizations using autocomplete. Use when you need to find organization suggestions based on a partial organization name for ticket creation, user assignment, or organization lookup. The `name` parameter is required - provide at least a few characters for meaningful autocomplete results. Returns organizations sorted by relevance.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: A substring of an organization name to search for. The API returns organizations whose name starts with or contains this substring. Case-insensitive matching is applied.

inputs.name: source
inputs.about: If a `field_id` is provided, this specifies the type of the field. For example, if the field is on a 'zen:user', it references a field on a user.

inputs.name: field_id
inputs.about: The ID of a lookup relationship field. The type of field is determined by the `source` parameter. Use this to filter results based on custom field values.

tools.name: List Organization Merges
tools.description: List all organization merge operations for a specific organization in Zendesk. This action retrieves the merge history showing which organizations were merged into or out of the specified organization. Use this action when you need to audit organization merge history or track the consolidation of organizations. Supports pagination to handle large result sets efficiently. This is a read-only, idempotent operation.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination. Traditional: `?page=2` (integer page number). Cursor: `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor`. These are mutually exclusive.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page. Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.

inputs.name: organization_id
inputs.about: The ID of the organization for which to retrieve merge history. Must be a positive integer.

tools.name: Show Many Organizations
tools.description: Show many Zendesk organizations by their IDs or external IDs. Use when you need to retrieve multiple organizations in a single API call. Accepts up to 100 organization IDs or external IDs as comma-separated lists. Only one of ids or external_ids should be provided. Returns organization objects with all standard fields including name, domain_names, tags, and organization_fields.

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of organization IDs to retrieve (max 100). Either this or external_ids is required.

inputs.name: external_ids
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of external organization IDs to retrieve (max 100). Either this or ids is required.

tools.name: Count Organization Tickets
tools.description: Count organization tickets in Zendesk. Returns an approximate count of tickets for a specific organization. Use when you need to know how many tickets are associated with an organization for reporting or operational purposes.

inputs.name: organization_id
inputs.about: Numeric ID of the organization whose tickets to count (e.g. 123456). Must be a non-null integer; cast to int if sourced from tools that return it as a string. Do not pass null (skip the call if organization_id is null). Obtain from ZENDESK_GET_ALL_ZENDESK_ORGANIZATIONS or ZENDESK_CREATE_ZENDESK_ORGA

tools.name: Get Organization Subscription
tools.description: Show Organization Subscription - retrieves details of a specific organization subscription by its ID. Use when you need to get information about an organization subscription, including the associated user and organization IDs, and the creation timestamp. This is a read-only operation that does not modify any data.

inputs.name: organization_subscription_id
inputs.about: The ID of the organization subscription to retrieve

tools.name: List Organization Subscriptions
tools.description: List Organization Subscriptions in Zendesk. Returns organization subscriptions with pagination support (cursor and offset). Use when you need to retrieve all organization subscriptions or need to paginate through results. End users only see their own subscriptions.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for offset pagination (1-100). Limited to first 100 pages or 10,000 records total.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of organization subscriptions per page (max 100).

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of organization subscriptions per page for cursor pagination (max 100). Use this for large datasets.

inputs.name: page_after
inputs.about: Cursor value to retrieve the next page of results. Obtained from previous response's 'after_cursor' or 'next' link.

inputs.name: page_before
inputs.about: Cursor value to retrieve the previous page of results. Obtained from previous response's 'before_cursor' or 'prev' link.

tools.name: Get Organization Tags
tools.description: List all tags associated with a specific Zendesk organization. Use when you need to retrieve the tags assigned to a particular organization for ticket categorization, filtering, or reporting purposes.

inputs.name: organization_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the organization whose tags to retrieve. Must be a non-null integer; cast to int if sourced from tools that return it as a string. Do not pass null (skip the call if organization_id is null). Obtain from ZENDESK_GET_ALL_ZENDESK_ORGANIZATIONS or ZENDESK_GET_ZENDESK_ORGANIZATION.

tools.name: Get Organization Tickets
tools.description: Get tickets for a specific Zendesk organization, potentially including tickets from multiple requesters. Supports offset pagination and sorting; the page parameter is limited to 100.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination (1-100). Limited to first 100 pages or 10,000 records total.

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: Field to sort by: 'assignee', 'created_at', 'id', 'priority', 'status', 'updated_at'

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of tickets per page (max 100).

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.about: Sort order: 'asc' or 'desc'

inputs.name: organization_id
inputs.about: The ID of the organization whose tickets to retrieve

tools.name: List Organization Users
tools.description: List users associated with a specific Zendesk organization. Supports filtering by role, permission set, or external ID, and pagination by page number.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for offset pagination (starts at 1). Cannot be used with cursor pagination (page[size] and page[after]/page[before]).

inputs.name: role
inputs.about: Filter results by a single role. Use 'end-user', 'agent', or 'admin'.

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: The field to sort users by. Defaults to natural order if not specified.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of users to return per page.

inputs.name: role_list
inputs.about: Filter results by multiple roles. Provide a list of roles to include users matching any of them.

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.about: The sort order for results. Defaults to 'asc' if not specified.

inputs.name: external_id
inputs.about: Filter by external ID. Must be unique per user under the same account.

inputs.name: permission_set
inputs.about: Filter by custom role ID. For Enterprise plan and above. Only one role ID per request.

inputs.name: organization_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the organization to list users from. Must be a non-null positive integer.

tools.name: Count Organization Users
tools.description: Count users in a specific Zendesk organization by ID. Returns an approximate count of users. Use when you need to know how many users belong to a particular organization for reporting or operational purposes.

inputs.name: role
inputs.about: Filters the results by role. Possible values are "end-user", "agent", "admin", or a custom role name.

inputs.name: permission_set
inputs.about: For custom roles which is available on the Enterprise plan and above. You can only filter by one role ID per request.

inputs.name: organization_id
inputs.about: Numeric ID of the organization to count users for (e.g. 16). Must be a non-null integer.

tools.name: Get Owned Apps
tools.description: List apps owned by the current Zendesk account. Use when you need to retrieve information about apps installed in your Zendesk instance, such as checking installed apps, reviewing app details (version, status, author), or auditing your app inventory. This endpoint requires admin authentication.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination. Use this to retrieve subsequent pages of results when there are many owned apps.

inputs.name: exclude
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of sideloaded objects to exclude from the response. Use this to reduce payload size. The exclude parameter removes the specified related objects (e.g., 'parameters,categories') from being returned alongside the apps.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of apps to return per page. Defaults to 25 if not specified, maximum is 100.

tools.name: List Ticket Problems
tools.description: List Zendesk ticket problems. Use when you need to retrieve all tickets of type 'problem' in your Zendesk account. The response is always ordered by updated_at by default; use sort_by and sort_order parameters to customize. Supports both offset and cursor-based pagination. Note: Problems are tickets with type='problem'. This endpoint specifically returns problem-type tickets which are linked to other incidents that share the same root cause.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for offset pagination (starts at 1). Cannot be used with cursor pagination.

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: Field to sort results by. Prefix with `-` for descending order. Common values: updated_at, created_at, id.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of problems to return per page (max 100). Cannot be used with cursor pagination.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of problems per page for cursor pagination (max 100). Use with page_after or page_before for large datasets.

inputs.name: page_after
inputs.about: Cursor value to retrieve the next page of results. Obtained from previous response's next link or cursor.

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.about: Sort order: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending.

inputs.name: page_before
inputs.about: Cursor value to retrieve the previous page of results. Obtained from previous response's prev link or cursor.

inputs.name: include_item_cursors
inputs.about: When true, includes cursor values for each item in the cursor pagination response. Only valid with cursor pagination (page_size, page_after, page_before).

inputs.name: include_boundary_indicators
inputs.about: When true, includes 'has_more' indicator in the cursor pagination response meta. Only valid with cursor pagination (page_size, page_after, page_before).

tools.name: List Public Locales
tools.description: List all available public locales that can be used for translations in Zendesk. Use when you need to enumerate supported languages/locales for your Zendesk account, display language options to users, or determine which locales are available for ticket or article translations. This is a read-only, idempotent operation that returns the complete list of public locales with no pagination parameters.

tools.name: Get Recent Tickets
tools.description: List recently viewed tickets in Zendesk. Returns tickets sorted by the time they were last viewed, most recent first. Useful for agents to quickly access tickets they've been working on. The endpoint returns tickets visible to the agent based on their permission restrictions. Pagination is limited to 10,000 records (100 pages * 100 per page). Use this action to retrieve the tickets an agent has recently accessed in the Zendesk interface.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for offset pagination (1-100). Limited to first 100 pages or 10,000 records total.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of tickets per page (max 100). Note: page * per_page cannot exceed 10,000.

tools.name: List Remote Authentications
tools.description: List all remote authentication configurations in your Zendesk account. Use this action when you need to enumerate SSO configurations, check which authentication methods are enabled, or retrieve metadata about remote authentication settings for agents and end users. This is a read-only, idempotent operation that returns all configured remote authentication providers including SAML, LDAP, JWT, and OAuth configurations.

tools.name: List Request Comments
tools.description: List a page of comments on a Zendesk request, with optional time and author-role filters. The response includes pagination information and may include comment content, attachments and metadata.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: traditional uses `?page=2` (integer page number); cursor uses `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor` (deepObject with size, after, before). Mutually exclusive.

inputs.name: role
inputs.about: Filter comments by the role of the author. One of 'agent' or 'end_user'. If not specified, all comments are returned regardless of author role.

inputs.name: since
inputs.about: Filters comments to include only those from the given datetime and later. Format as ISO 8601 UTC timestamp (e.g., '2024-01-15T00:00:00Z').

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page. Maximum is 100 records per page for the request comments endpoint.

inputs.name: request_id
inputs.about: The ID of the request to retrieve comments for.

tools.name: List CCD Requests
tools.description: List CCD Requests. Use when you need to retrieve requests where the authenticated end user is listed as a CC (carbon copy) recipient. These are requests the user is watching but did not create. Supports sorting by creation or update timestamps.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for offset pagination (1-100). Limited to first 100 pages.

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: Field to sort requests by. Possible values are 'updated_at' or 'created_at'.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of requests per page for offset pagination (max 100).

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.about: Sort order direction. One of 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'asc'.

tools.name: Get Request Comment
tools.description: Get a specific comment from a Zendesk request. Use when you need to retrieve a single comment by its ID for a given request, such as displaying a specific comment detail or checking comment metadata. This action is read-only and idempotent.

inputs.name: request_id
inputs.about: The ID of the request

inputs.name: ticket_comment_id
inputs.about: The ID of the ticket comment

tools.name: Search Requests
tools.description: Search for requests in Zendesk using query syntax. Use when you need to find customer requests across Zendesk using flexible search criteria such as status, priority, subject, or requester information. Returns paginated results with request details. This action is read-only and idempotent - searching for requests does not modify any data.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination (starts at 1). Increment until results array is empty to retrieve all matching requests.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: The syntax and matching logic for the string is detailed in the Zendesk Support search reference. See Query basics in the Tickets API documentation. Examples: 'status:open', 'type:request', 'priority:high', 'subject:fire'

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: Field to sort results by. Options: 'updated_at', 'created_at', 'status', 'priority'. Defaults to sorting by relevance if not specified.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of results per page (max 100).

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.about: Sort order direction. Options: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc' if not specified.

tools.name: List Solved Requests
tools.description: List Zendesk requests with the 'solved' status. Useful for reviewing completed customer requests, generating reports on resolution times, or tracking customer satisfaction. Use this action when you need to retrieve requests that have been marked as solved.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: Traditional: `?page=2` (integer page number). Cursor: `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor` (deepObject with size, after, before). These are mutually exclusive - use one format or the other, not both.

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: Sort field options for listing solved requests.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page. Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.about: Sort order options for listing solved requests.

tools.name: Get Agent Attribute Values
tools.description: Retrieve routing attribute values for specified Zendesk agents using the Skill-Based Routing API, such as their skills or qualifications. Results can be requested with a page size of 1–100.

inputs.name: agent_ids
inputs.about: A list of agent IDs whose attribute values to retrieve

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: The number of items to return per page

tools.name: List Satisfaction Ratings
tools.description: List Zendesk ticket satisfaction ratings for reviewing customer feedback and CSAT scores. Supports page-number pagination and sorting.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about:
Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination:

- Traditional: `?page=2` (integer page number)
- Cursor: `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor` (deepObject with size, after, before)

These are mutually exclusive - use one format or the other, not both.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about:
Field to sort results by. Prefix with `-` for descending order.

When used with cursor pagination, this determines the cursor ordering.

Example: `?sort=name` or `?sort=-created_at`

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page (max 100).

tools.name: Count Satisfaction Ratings
tools.description: Count satisfaction ratings in Zendesk. Returns an approximate count of satisfaction ratings. Use when you need to know how many satisfaction ratings exist for reporting or operational purposes.

tools.name: Get Search Results Count
tools.description: Count the number of items matching a search query in Zendesk. Use when you need to know how many results a search would return without fetching all the actual results. This is useful for displaying result counts before executing a full search.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: The search query string. Supports Zendesk query syntax for filtering by type, status, priority, etc. Example: 'type:ticket status:open priority:urgent' or 'assignee:me status:pending'.

tools.name: Export Search Results
tools.description: Export Zendesk search results in batches using cursor pagination. Use the response's after_cursor value as page_after to fetch the next page.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: The search query string. Supports Zendesk query syntax for filtering by type, status, priority, etc. Example: 'type:ticket status:open priority:urgent' or 'assignee:me status:pending'.

inputs.name: include
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of sideloads to include in the response. Available sideloads depend on the search result types (e.g., 'users', 'organizations').

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: The number of results shown per page (max 100).

inputs.name: page_after
inputs.about: Cursor token for fetching the next page of results.

inputs.name: filter_type
inputs.about: The object type returned by the export query. Can be 'ticket', 'organization', 'user', or 'group'.

tools.name: Get Security Settings
tools.description: Show Security Settings for a Zendesk account. Use when you need to retrieve the security configuration of a Zendesk account, including session timeouts, password policies, two-factor authentication settings, IP restrictions, and account assumption options. This is a read-only, idempotent operation that does not modify any data. This action is useful for auditing security settings, verifying compliance requirements, or understanding the security posture of a Zendesk account.

tools.name: List Side Conversation Events
tools.description: Retrieve side conversation events for incremental export. Returns events created since the specified start_time in chronological order. Use when you need to export or sync side conversation events for backup, analytics, or integration purposes. This action supports pagination via the next_page URL which contains a next_start_time parameter — pass that timestamp as start_time for subsequent requests. Only available to Admins. Note: This is a read-only, idempotent action suitable for building event pipelines or audit trails.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for offset pagination. Zendesk returns up to 1000 events per page for incremental exports.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of events per page (max 1000 for incremental exports).

inputs.name: start_time
inputs.about: A Unix timestamp for the query start time for incremental exports. Returns events created at or after this time. Use this parameter to paginate through large result sets by using the timestamp from the last event in the previous page.

tools.name: Get Support Address
tools.description: Get a support address by its unique ID. Use when you have a support_address_id and need to retrieve details including the email address, brand association, and DNS verification statuses. This is a read-only operation.

inputs.name: support_address_id
inputs.about: The ID of the support address to retrieve.

tools.name: List Tags
tools.description: List Zendesk tags and their usage counts to identify frequently used tags. Returns one page, with an optional page size of up to 100 and a sort field.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: Traditional: `?page=2` (integer page number). Cursor: `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor` (deepObject with size, after, before). These are mutually exclusive - use one format or the other, not both.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Field to sort results by. Prefix with `-` for descending order. Example: `?sort=name` or `?sort=-created_at`

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page (max 100). Note: Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.

tools.name: Count Tags
tools.description: Count Tags in Zendesk. Returns an approximate count of tags. Use when you need to know how many tags exist in your Zendesk account for reporting or operational purposes.

tools.name: Show Target
tools.description: Show a specific target by its ID. Use when you have a target ID and need to retrieve its details including title, type, active status, and creation timestamp. This is a read-only, idempotent operation that returns a single target object. This action is irreversible for data retrieval - it only reads target information, no destructive changes occur.

inputs.name: target_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the target to retrieve

tools.name: Show Target Failure
tools.description: Show a target failure in Zendesk. Use when you have a target_failure_id and need to retrieve details about a failed target execution, including the HTTP status code, raw request/response data, and consecutive failure count. This is a read-only operation.

inputs.name: target_failure_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the target failure to retrieve.

tools.name: List Target Failures
tools.description: List the 25 most recent target failures in Zendesk. Target failures occur when a target (webhook, callback, or external integration) fails to execute properly. Each failure record includes the request sent, response received, and status code. Use this action to monitor and troubleshoot failing integrations.

tools.name: List Targets
tools.description: List all targets for the current Zendesk account. Use when you need to retrieve, audit, or review the targets configured in your Zendesk account. Targets are endpoints that receive data when triggers or automations fire. This is a read-only, idempotent action with no required parameters.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for offset pagination. Zendesk returns up to 100 targets per page.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of targets per page for offset pagination (max 100).

tools.name: Get Ticket Audit
tools.description: Retrieve a specific Zendesk ticket audit by ticket ID and audit ID. Returns its events and selected audit details and metadata.

inputs.name: ticket_id
inputs.about: The ID of the ticket

inputs.name: ticket_audit_id
inputs.about: The ID of the ticket audit

tools.name: List Ticket Collaborators
tools.description: List all collaborators (CC'd users) on a Zendesk ticket. Use when you need to see who is currently CC'd on a ticket, such as when coordinating with multiple stakeholders or before adding/removing collaborators. Each collaborator is a user object with basic profile information. Paginate through results using page and per_page parameters.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination (starts at 1).

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of collaborators per page (max 100).

inputs.name: ticket_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the ticket whose collaborators to retrieve.

tools.name: Get Ticket Comments
tools.description: List comments on a Zendesk ticket, including available author, content and attachment details. Supports sort order, page size and inclusion of inline images; comment body fields may be absent.

inputs.name: include
inputs.about: Accepts 'users'. Use this parameter to list email CCs by side-loading users. Example: `?include=users`. Note: If the comment source is email, a deleted user will be represented as the CC'd email address. If the comment source is anything else, a deleted user will be represented as the user name.

inputs.name: per_page
inputs.about: Number of records to return per page (max 100).

inputs.name: ticket_id
inputs.about: The ID of the ticket to retrieve comments for.

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.about: Sort order for comments. Defaults to 'asc' (oldest first). Use 'desc' for newest first.

inputs.name: include_inline_images
inputs.about: When true, inline images are also listed as attachments in the response. Defaults to false.

tools.name: List Ticket Email CCs
tools.description: List email CCs for a specified Zendesk ticket, returning available user details and pagination information.

inputs.name: ticket_id
inputs.about: The ID of the ticket to list email CCs for.

tools.name: Show Ticket Field
tools.description: Show a specific ticket field by its ID. Use when you need to retrieve details of a single ticket field in your Zendesk account, such as for auditing, understanding field configuration, or validating field properties. This action is read-only and idempotent.

inputs.name: creator
inputs.about: If true, displays the `creator_user_id` and `creator_app_name` properties. If the ticket field is created by an app, `creator_app_name` is the name of the app and `creator_user_id` is `-1`. If the ticket field is not created by an app, then `creator_app_name` is null

inputs.name: ticket_field_id
inputs.about: The ID of the ticket field

tools.name: List Ticket Fields
tools.description: List all system and custom ticket fields in Zendesk. Use when you need to retrieve field definitions for building forms, validating field values, or understanding available ticket field structure. Supports cursor-based pagination for large datasets. When creator=true is specified, includes creator_user_id and creator_app_name for each field. Locale parameter affects dynamic content variants for title_in_portal.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Field to sort results by. Prefix with - for descending order. Example: name or -created_at.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.about: Forces the title_in_portal property to return a dynamic content variant for the specified locale. Only accepts active locale IDs.

inputs.name: creator
inputs.about: Displays the creator_user_id and creator_app_name properties. If created by an app, creator_app_name shows the app name and creator_user_id is -1.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of records per page for cursor pagination (max 100).

inputs.name: page_after
inputs.about: Cursor token to fetch records after this position. Obtain from previous response's cursor values.

inputs.name: page_before
inputs.about: Cursor token to fetch records before this position. Obtain from previous response's cursor values.

inputs.name: include_item_cursors
inputs.about: When true, includes cursor values for each item in the cursor pagination response. Only valid with cursor pagination.

inputs.name: include_boundary_indicators
inputs.about: When true, includes has_more indicator in the cursor pagination response meta. Only valid with cursor pagination.

tools.name: Count Ticket Fields
